featuresPage.seoTitle: Features – bazaar software with QR labels and smartphone checkout | BazarPro
featuresPage.seoDescription: Seller registration, QR labels, drop-off and checkout by smartphone, automatic settlement: all features for children's clothing bazaars, bike sales and flea markets.
featuresPage.title: Everything for your bazaar – <highlight>in one app</highlight>
featuresPage.intro: From seller registration to checkout to payout: BazarPro replaces paper lists, handwritten labels and counting cash in the evening.

qrLabels.title: QR labels without prices
qrLabels.text: Sellers print the labels themselves as a PDF. Since there is no price on them, discounts during the bazaar work without reprinting.

phoneCheckout.title: Checkout on your smartphone
phoneCheckout.text: Drop-off and sales run through the phone camera in the browser. No till, scanner or app needed.

settlement.title: Settlement at the push of a button
settlement.text: Sales, commission and payout are settled for every seller – no lists, no recounting.

live.title: Live for sellers
live.text: Sellers instantly see what has sold, get an email and can give a discount on items that are still for sale.

map.title: Site map & locations
map.text: Visitors scan an item and see its price and location, e.g. “Hall B, table 4”.

registration.title: Registration under control
registration.text: Access code, participant limit, allowed categories and co-organizers for your team of helpers.

rules.title: Your rules for each bazaar
rules.text: You decide whether there are discounts, from when and up to what percentage, and whether price offers or questions are allowed.

negotiate.title: Haggle like at a flea market
negotiate.text: Buyers send price offers online, or the checkout sells down to the minimum price the seller has set.

questions.title: Questions on the item
questions.text: Interested buyers ask publicly about size or condition, the seller answers, and everyone sees the answer.

useCases.title: For every second-hand bazaar
useCases.text: Wherever sellers drop off their things and a team sells them.

list.registration: Online seller registration with access code and participant limit
list.listing: Enter items online with photo and price
list.scan: Drop-off and checkout by smartphone scan
list.discounts: Discounts during the bazaar, from a set time
list.offers: Price offers and negotiable prices with a minimum price
list.questions: Public questions and answers on items
list.categoryFields: Extra fields per category, e.g. frame number or size
list.emails: Email to sellers when an item sells, receipt by email for buyers

features.instant: Ready right away – just sign up

selfHosted.name: Self-host
selfHosted.priceNote: you only pay for your server

free.question: Is BazarPro really free?
free.answer: Yes. All features are free for organizers, sellers and visitors – no subscription, no trial period and no limit on bazaars or sellers.

commission.question: Does BazarPro earn money from my bazaar?
commission.answer: No. You set the commission you keep from the sales as an organizer yourself – and all of it stays with you.

hardware.question: Do I need a till or a scanner?
hardware.answer: No. Drop-off and sales run in the browser using the camera of a smartphone or tablet. You print labels on regular paper.

selfHost.question: Can I run BazarPro on my own server?
selfHost.answer: Yes. BazarPro is open source under the MIT license. With Docker Compose it runs on your own server – the guide is in the documentation at docs.bazarpro.de.
